description: Get a swap quote for the linked user — EVM (via LiFi) or Solana (via Jupiter). Read-only: returns the estimated output and directs the user to complete the swap in the Swop app. For EVM, pass chain plus token ADDRESSES; for Solana, omit chain and pass token MINTS. Amounts are in the input token's base units.

amount.description: Input amount in base units (wei / lamports / token decimals)

chain.description: EVM chain for a LiFi quote: base, ethereum, polygon, arbitrum, optimism, or a numeric chain id. Omit for a Solana (Jupiter) quote.

inputMint.description: Input token: EVM contract address, or Solana mint

outputMint.description: Output token: EVM address, or Solana mint (default USDC)

name: swop_get_swap_quote
title: Get a token swap quote
